commander_identity.mechanical_plan: Sol'Kanar is a 2UBR 5/5 whose own end-step trigger chooses one previously unchosen draw/drain/bolt/transfer mode per battlefield object. Optimize reliable noncreature-spell and end-step blinking to repeat profitable choices while giving cursed permanents (Pact, Coil, Illusions, Archfiend, Greed's Gambit) to opponents and recovering owned Sol through Planar Incision, Homeward Path, Coveted Falcon and now Brand.
commander_identity.natural_ceiling: Bracket 4 Optimized. Repeated 5MV end-step mode payoffs, compact Pact and Coil transfer kills, but multiple turns and interactive donations prevent treating this as a turbo cEDH shell.
commander_identity.anti_homogenization: No Thoracle/Consultation, generic Breach or high-cost unthemed Grixis finisher. Actual transfer/blink/exact curse support first.

whole_deck_audit.roles_and_overlaps: All original 99 noncommander physical copies were individually examined from the Oct20 M6 comprehensive review and newly enumerated 99-slot ledger. Preserve 35 lands, nine colorless/colored accelerators, 2 recurring end-step reset permanents, one 2MV owner-rescue blink, Pact/Coil plus seven-plus curse/gift lines and unusually broad reactive suite. Six selected cuts remove expensive indirect/political effects rather than the actual donor/curse engine.
whole_deck_audit.mana_base_and_curve: 35 unchanged physical lands (Island x3, Mountain x3, Swamp x4) and nine unchanged rocks; five-mana 2UBR commander has three colored pips. Familiar's blue/red discount is only ONE generic even for a multicolored Sol'Kanar, and may be removed. Wishclaw is two mana plus one activation rather than raw ramp; six swaps do not replace colored fixing. Red/blue pitch count to Force of Will falls from 28 other blue nonland cards to 24, remaining playable.
whole_deck_audit.interaction_resilience: Retain free Force of Will, Fierce Guardianship, Deflecting Swat, Deadly Rollick, Swan Song, Mana Drain, Ertai flash counter, Withering Torment, Rift, Vandalblast, Deluge, Blasphemous Act and Spiteful Banditry. Losing Propaganda exposes combat defense but Alexios and Agent press other opponents; losing Reins reduces temporary instant combat blowouts.

whole_deck_audit.off_ranked_search_conclusion: Kitten and Brand are missed in the original donor/blink baseline; Goldnight Castigator, Ebon Drake, Jinxed Ring, Ghostly Flicker, Order of Succession, Modify Memory, Rust Elemental and generic counters were weighed against the whole 100 rather than copied from lift ranking. Stronger 8-card cut set sacrifices mandatory flexible answers.

final_changes.coherent_package_tradeoff: Six actual identity-positive swaps: one repeatable self-blink, one generic-cost reducer for U/R spells, instant owned-permanent recovery with dangerous-curse caveat, aggressive automatic across-upkeep creature gift, one-mana upkeep liability, and a tutor that literally gifts an artifact. Lose Suit's temporary transfer, Chimera's reactive exchange, Reins combat surprise, Visions opponent-opponent switch, saga's multi-turn exchange, and Propaganda attack tax; core Pact/Coil/Illusions and donor redundancy kept.

final_candidate.deckwide_reconciliation: Exact six one-for-one changes to canonical Oct15 100, 100 physical/93 distinct names, Island 3/Mountain 3/Swamp 4 only repeats, 35 land cards unchanged; 1 commander, no companion, UBR, no project exceptions.

low_swap_heightened_audit.off_ranked_opportunities: EDHREC high lift plus theme pages and off-ranking Kitten/Brand/Wishclaw assessed; selected engine improvements materially address mode timing/owner recovery, unlike 28 prior M5 weak benchmark proposals.

multi_slot_packages.result_and_rationale: Genuine full 100-card alt8 staged. Two more engine pieces Ghostly Flicker/Jinxed Ring improve blink and gift burden but eliminate flexible Ertai ability counter and emergency Goblin sacrifice; tighter theoretical theme but worse stack integrity.

Genuine full 100-card alternate 6 kept Propaganda defensive tax and cut Kain instead of it; preserves defensive turns but removes an autonomous on-hit donation creature that overlaps profitably with Alexios and Khârn.

low_swap_heightened_audit.alternate_cuts_for_prior_holds: Against original M6 HOLD on Chimera/Suit, six other distinct role slots were challenged, and Ghostly Flicker/Jinxed Ring were built into alt8 rather than accepted without source-paid cut scrutiny.
low_swap_heightened_audit.strongest_argument_against_baseline: Current list contains five-mana Chimera, seven-mana equipped Assault Suit and multistage trickster saga, while commander mode engine has only Thassa/Closet/Incision. Replacing indirect chaos with Kitten and Familiar creates meaningful repeatability and castability gains.
low_swap_heightened_audit.evidence_based_answer: Six identity-centered changes passed role scrutiny. There are credible more-than-six additions but they cost indispensable Ertai and sacrifice outlet; ending at six reflects preserving critical interaction and—not an arbitrary five-swap ceiling.

open_ended_optimization_audit.remaining_99_review: After the initial five-worthy cards, the live 99 slots were re-reviewed for Puca transfer, Bowmasters, Ertai trigger counter, Goblin sacrifice, Spiteful Banditry board wipe, Dross oil kill, nonbasic fixing, Kain and major giftable liabilities. Wishclaw was added as sixth on native tutorable Pact/Offering access. A genuine eight-swap variant was authored and rejected only after comparing emergency safety roles.

post_floor_challenges.tradeoff: Two-creature or land-and-Sol bounce can reset modes or protect a threat, but 2UB flash Ertai counters spell AND activated/triggered abilities (including fatal or transfer modes) while Flicker cannot interact with the hostile spell stack.

Jinxed Ring is a low-cost giftable damage trap; Bombardment has no mana activation and can sacrifice Sol before a dangerous fourth-mode resolution, and Ring damage is conditional and can be donated onward.

larger_swap_packages.case_for_extra_swaps: Additional Ghostly Flicker gives burst protection and resets, Jinxed Ring another cheap transferrable cursed artifact, coherent eighth-swap pressure package.
larger_swap_packages.why_not_selected: Removing Ertai and Goblin Bombardment destroys two distinct emergency outs to commander mode four and hostile Pact/Coil trigger pressure. The deck already has three repeatable or one-shot blink paths, and the extra gift Ring is less deterministic than existing seven liabilities.

open_ended_optimization_audit.quality_based_stop_reason: Continue research past five, include sixth Wishclaw, and build physically real eight-swap package; stop at six because remaining credible cards displace unique on-stack trigger counter, free self-sac rescue, or slower-but-repeatable nonland donation, increasing attrition vulnerability for only redundant gift or blink.
